description: Compute experimental pristine reference (mean of 462 IQS pristine cases) and use it for CFDAC + indicators on experimental data, instead of the synth pristine mean. Modal / frf_mag / timeseries unaffected.

type.cell: best shifted from cnn2d/cfdac_mag to mlp/modal; per-cell mixed (cnn2d/cfdac_phase +0.115, cnn2d/cfdac_imag -0.132)

notes: 3/5 tasks improve; mass_location +0.25 is the largest single lift. Type regresses because synth-trained CFDAC backbones partly exploited the synth-vs-synth ref bias as a cross-domain shortcut; this drops to be recovered after backbones retrain on aligned features (P1). Modal/frf_mag/timeseries unchanged confirms the fix is surgical and only touches reference-dependent features.

description: Add sigmoid squash to all 5 torch regression heads (MLP, Conv1D, Transformer, Conv2D, Conv3D) gated on (regression AND bounded_output). Severity targets are normalized [0,1] per type (tasks.py:60), so the squash is correct; indicator predictors target raw unbounded values, so bounded_output=False is forwarded from train_indicator_predictors.py and the eval routine. State dicts unchanged -- existing .pt artefacts load and run with the new sigmoid post-hoc.

severity_detail.cells_finite: 17/17 vs 13/17 in baseline (some were overflow large negatives)

notes: Severity goes from best=-0.020 (R^2) to best=+0.180 -- a +0.20 lift from a single line of code per model. Catastrophic MLP failures (R^2 ~ -10^22) collapse to mundane negative R^2 (-1.2). Indicator predictors correctly get bounded_output=False so their raw unbounded predictions are surfaced (this is the truth -- they were never trained with target normalization; that's a P1 problem).
